---
title: "Energy Bins"
---

## The `BINNING` Command

The `BINNING` command controls how particles are grouped into energy bins for
solver and multi-bunch workflows that use energy-resolved sub-structures.

In practice, energy bins interact with:

- `DISTRIBUTION` attributes such as `NBIN` and `SBIN`
- field-solver settings that support energy-binned calculations
- multi-bunch and restart workflows in OPAL-cycl

The chapter is short in the legacy manual and mainly exists to document the
available command attributes and their interaction with solver setup.
